description: Prompt 48 (protocol 10): Forge's land facts and the observed game. The player plays green lands, Exploration (an additional land each turn) and Rampant Growth (a basic land from the library onto the battlefield - not a land play); Forge says why a land of the hand cannot be played (the land for the turn is played, not the player's turn, not now). The AI's turns - lands, creatures, burn, attacks - arrive as observations with their public results.
